name: Rocket Rush Simulator🚀
desc:
Welcome to Rocket Launch Sim! Mine for ores, upgrade your gear, and blast off into space! Explore fantastical planets as you journey your way through the solar system. 

🌌Update 2🌌
-New premium currency "Void Crystals"
-Void booster, uses Void Crystals to earn extra XP and Cash!
-Mid-flight refuel using Void Crystals!
-Rebirth rocket skins for rebirths 1, 3 and 5
-Earn Void Crystals from treasure, ranking up, and rebirthing!

🐛Post bugs and suggestions on the group wall🐛:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/11010524

Scripting by Sir_Falstaff
Environment Design & Building by TipToesTim
